wordle.title: Word of the day
wordle.description: Guess the hidden word in {{max}} tries at most. The final word is related to Catholicism. It may be a proper noun. Each word has {{length}} letters. After each attempt, the colors show whether a letter is in the right place (green), present elsewhere in the word (yellow) or absent (gray).

guessCard.title: Guess the card
guessCard.description: A saint card is heavily zoomed in: guess who it is in {{guesses}} tries at most. Each mistake zooms the card out and costs 5 XP. Level 1: zoom. Level 2: the card is also grayed out. Level 3: it is also flipped.

memory.title: Memory
memory.description: Find the {{pairs}} pairs of cards. They come from the same family or are linked to each other. The fewer moves you make, the more XP you earn; in case of a tie, the fastest wins.

sections.title: 1. Purpose
text: These terms govern the use of Nuée de Témoins ("the Service"), published by LECONTE Augustin. By creating an account, you accept them.

sections.title: 2. Account
text: You are responsible for your account and your username. Usernames that are offensive, impersonate a third party or are unlawful may be changed or deleted.

sections.title: 3. Your data
text: The data you entrust to us (email address, name, profile picture, username, country, language, progress, achievements, friends, patron saint) is used solely to operate the Service.
It is not sold, transferred or used for any other commercial purpose. Details are provided in the Privacy Policy.

sections.title: 4. Advertising
text: The Service is free and funded by advertising. Ads are provided by Adsense. We do not pass your profile data to them. Depending on your consent choices, the ad provider may use identifiers to personalize ads.

sections.title: 5. Content and intellectual property
text: The Service, its code and its graphic elements are protected. Some data and icons come from third-party sites, credited on the Credits page.

sections.title: 6. Account deletion
text: You can delete your account at any time from your profile page. Your data is then erased.

sections.title: 7. Availability and liability
text: The Service is provided "as is", with no guarantee of continuous availability. We may modify or discontinue it.

sections.title: 8. Changes to the terms
text: If these terms change significantly, you will be asked to accept them again.

sections.title: 9. Governing law and contact
text: These terms are governed by French law. Contact: augustin@familleleconte.fr.

sections.title: Data controller
text: LECONTE Augustin, 26260 BREN, augustin@familleleconte.fr.

sections.title: Data collected
items: Account: email address, name and profile picture (depending on your sign-in method).
Profile: username, country, language, patron saint.
Game activity: progress, level, achievements, friendships.
Technical data: connection logs (IP address, date) required for security.

sections.title: Purposes and legal bases
items: Provide the Service and manage your account (performance of a contract).
Ensure security and prevent abuse (legitimate interest).

sections.title: Use of data
text: Your data is not sold and is not used for commercial profiling. It is used solely to operate the Service.

sections.title: Recipients
text: Your data is hosted by Netlify (France). The authentication provider Neon processes your sign-in. The ad provider Adsense may process advertising identifiers depending on your consent choices.

sections.title: Retention period
text: Account data is kept as long as your account exists, then deleted when you delete your account. Technical logs are kept for 12 months at most.

sections.title: Local storage
text: The app uses your device's storage for your session and preferences (theme, language). These items are strictly necessary for the Service to work.

sections.title: Your rights
text: You have the rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability and objection. You can delete your account from your profile or write to us at augustin@familleleconte.fr. You may also lodge a complaint with the CNIL (cnil.fr).

sections.title: Minors
text: The Service is intended for people aged 15 and over. Below that age, parental consent is required.

sections.title: Data not collected
items: Contacts, messages, photos from your device

sections.title: Sharing
text: Your data is neither sold nor shared for commercial purposes. Only our technical providers (hosting, authentication) access it to operate the Service. The ad provider may receive advertising identifiers depending on your consent.

sections.title: Protection
items: Restricted and authenticated access to data
No password stored in plain text

sections.title: Deletion
text: You can delete your account and all your data from the profile page at any time.

sections.title: Icons and illustrations
text: Thanks to the creators whose work illustrates the app.
